fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: Gloas fork transition tested successfully with Lido and Optimism; devnet torn down
Besu investigating performance issue on glamsterdam-devnet-8; improvements in progress
Sepolia fork confirmed October 6th; client releases due by Monday September 29th. Nethermind released, Geth released, Besu ETA tomorrow, Reth next week, ethrex today/tomorrow
200M gas limit at Glamsterdam fork approved for Sepolia; JUMPDEST attack causes 9–13s block execution times — reorg risk identified but deemed expensive/non-persistent

glamsterdam_gas_limit.highlight: JUMPDEST analysis attack via pre-deployed contract triggers valid blocks taking 8–13s to execute across all clients on glamsterdam-devnet-8
Maria: state creation gas increase (EIP-8037) makes <150M gas limit dangerous — some txs require ~90M gas alone, risking base fee volatility
Ansgar: testnets should stress-test aggressively; being gentle on Sepolia risks mainnet surprises

cl_block_retention_window.highlight: EIP-8061 changed exit/consolidation churn but block retention window wasn't updated; needs alignment. Related: EIP-8383 (Hegota PFI) would reduce it further
BAL retention window should equal CL block retention window; current CL window ~5 months (33k epochs), EIP-8061 would halve it to ~2 months (14k epochs)
Marius: too-short blob retention makes full sync impossible as sequential block execution exceeds slot time at higher gas limits
Potuz: if EL doesn't keep payloads/BALs, CL must — duplicating data; EL must keep at minimum what CL requires

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-8304 (Trustless Log Index): DFI for Hegota; author will continue work independently
EIP-7979 (Call and Return Opcodes for EVM): CFI — Solidity confirmed support, Nethermind/Besu/Nethermind upgraded ratings; ethrex soft DFI but non-blocking
EIP-8163 (Reserve EXTENSION 0xae opcode): CFI — low-cost no-op on L1; Arbitrum Nitro, Tron, Rootstock demand cited
EIP-8360 (TCREATE opcode): deferred — Glamsterdam removes gas refunds for ephemeral contracts; decision linked to self-destruct deprecation discussion
EIP-8368 and EIP-8372: remain PFI pending ≥30 days of mainnet Glamsterdam data before decision

CFI batch: EIP-7906 (State Diff Assertions), EIP-8250 (Keyed Nonces/Frames), EIP-8272 (Recent Roots/Frames), EIP-7668 (Remove Bloom Filters), EIP-8253 (Bump Zero-Nonce Storage Accounts), EIP-3298 (Remove Storage Refunds), EIP-8131 (Unified Tx Content Floor)
EIP-8131 (Unified Tx Content Floor) and BAL block access list byte floor EIP CFI'd as a bundle — pricing all payload bytes at floor requires both together
EIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM): strong CFI interest from most clients; Besu wants 2 more weeks; punted to next call

action_items.action: Open ETH R&D Discord thread to align on CL block retention window reduction and BAL window alignment; not blocking for Gloas
EIP-8360 champion (Milos) to engage clients; clients to review before next call for decision alongside self-destruct deprecation
nixo to post list of remaining ~10 Hegota EIPs (incl. EIP-8298) to ExecutionDev and EthRD channels before next call

decisions.decision: 200M gas limit signaled at Glamsterdam fork for Sepolia (not phased; starts trending up via 1/1024 voting post-fork)
CL block retention window reduction is not a hard fork change and not blocking Gloas; to be resolved async
DFI for Hegota: EIP-8304 (Trustless Log Index)
CFI for Hegota: EIP-7979 (Call and Return Opcodes for EVM)
CFI for Hegota: EIP-8163 (Reserve EXTENSION 0xae opcode)
EIP-8368 and EIP-8372 remain PFI pending mainnet Glamsterdam data (≥30 days post-fork)
CFI for Hegota: EIP-7906, EIP-8250, EIP-8272, EIP-7668, EIP-8253, EIP-3298, EIP-8131, and BAL byte floor EIP (bundled with EIP-8131)
